question: Which of the following word is the ANTONYM of the word 'boundaries' used in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Cores**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: 
 
 
• "Boundaries" means s**omething that indicates bounds or limits; a limiting or bounding line**.

 
 
• Example: By drawing boundaries against wrongful conduct, law provides a protective zone of freedom.
 
 
 
• **"Cores" means** **the central or most important part of something**.
 
 
• Example: The core of the city is beautifully designed.
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that the word "cores" is the antonym of the word "boundaries."

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let us understand the meanings of the other given words:
 
 
• "Verges" means the narrow piece of land at the side of a road, path, etc. that is usually covered in grass
 
• "Rims" means an edge at the top or outside of something that is round.
 
• "Brinks" means the edge of a cliff or other high area, or the point at which something good or bad will happen.
